text:
Maya: quick question — can we add a prioritizer to the onboarding queue that boosts accounts with high renewal risk and low last-touch recency? want automated tagging so AMs get the top 50 daily :eyes:
Jordan: yes — seems doable. are we thinking score = renewal_risk * recency_decay?
Alex C.: That formula could be noisy. I'd cap recency weight and also exclude accounts with onboarding stage = completed.
Lia (CS Ops): idea: use current healthscore, renewal_risk, last_support_touch_days. Prioritize: healthscore < 60 and renewal_risk > 0.6 and last_support_touch_days > 30 => tag "priority_onboard"
Maya: exactly. Can we make it a playbook rule that runs nightly and writes a tag + creates an AM task? maybe with a dry-run mode first.
Jordan: I'll draft the rule. proposal (pseudo):
```sql
SELECT account_id
FROM account_metrics
WHERE healthscore < 60
  AND renewal_risk >= 0.6
  AND last_support_touch_days >= 30
ORDER BY renewal_risk DESC, last_support_touch_days DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
Alex C.: For safety, add dedupe: if tag already present or last_task_created < 14 days then skip. Also add a confidence_reason field for telemetry.
Lia (CS Ops): +1 on confidence_reason. We should surface the rule inputs to the AM task: current healthscore, last_activity, playbook_version.
Maya: Can sam-bot run a dry-run and report counts so we can tune thresholds?
sam-bot: [playbook-run] queued: onboarding-prioritizer-v1 (dry-run) by Jordan. starting...
Sam-bot: [playbook-run] dry-run complete — matched 128 accounts; 40 already tagged; 88 new candidates. output artifact => /playbooks/runs/1790000001/dryrun.csv
Jordan: nice. 88 is a good starting number. I'll lower threshold to renewal_risk >= 0.65 and re-run tomorrow.
Alex C.: can we add an add-on check to avoid accounts with active sales negotiation (deal_stage in ["negotiation", "contract"]) — we don't want to duplicate AM outreach flows.
Lia (CS Ops): noted. I'll coordinate with Sales Ops to sync the deal_stage webhook so the playbook skips those.
Maya: timeline? want to flip to write-mode after one more dry-run and an AM pilot next Tuesday.
Jordan: I'll do one more dry-run Friday EOD with risk >= 0.65 and share the sample. then we can schedule pilot slack notif to a small AM cohort. :calendar:
Maya: thanks — moving to action. tagging @Lia (CS Ops) for handoff to enablement for AM templates. :thumbsup:
